note: Craft options whose ILLUSTRATION depicts a different craft. Append-only. Nothing here is auto-corrected: a repoint needs evidence, and an owner-approved photo is never unpublished on account of its drawing (V4 §5).

findings.label: Both Sides Double (Lapel Buttonhole Position)
findings.defect: GTECP is an INTERIOR POCKET position field, not a lapel field. GTECP/E ("Each side double") draws an opened jacket interior with two marks on EACH inner facing. It is behind a LAPEL buttonhole option.
findings.evidence: Opened GTECP/E: jacket shown from the inside, both facings visible, two red marks per side. Its sibling values are Left / Right / Left double / Both sides / Each side double / None — interior pocket positions.
findings.liveImageAssessment: CORRECT for the option — the photograph shows two buttonholes on each lapel. The text specification carried the count and the render recovered despite the wrong reference.
findings.action: NONE TAKEN. The owner approved this photograph and it is right, so it stays live (V4 §5). The drawing is still wrong and must not be used for any regeneration; a correct lapel-position plate has to be found first. Do not repoint on a guess.
findings.alsoAffects: GTECP is simultaneously the top label-match candidate for coin-pocket, namecard-pocket and inner-ticket-pocket. Because it is an interior field, coin-pocket (a hip-pocket craft) is excluded; namecard-pocket and inner-ticket-pocket remain indistinguishable from the drawing alone.

findings.label: No Fly Topstitch (Fly Stitching)
findings.defect: The 31A* plates are the POCKET topstitch family - 31A1 (0.15cm), 31A9 (0.1+0.7 double), 31A6 (no topstitch) all back pocket-stitching. The fly option borrowed 31A6, so one plate now serves two different crafts on different parts of the trouser.
findings.evidence: 31A6 is simultaneously the illustration for pocket-stitching/pocket-stitch-none and fly-stitching/fly-stitch-none across all three trouser-bearing products.
findings.liveImageAssessment: CORRECT for the option - navy trousers, front view, a clean fly with no topstitch line. The path is misfiled under /generated/jacket/ for a TROUSER craft, but the picture itself is right.
findings.action: NONE TAKEN. The owner approved this photograph on all three rows and it is right, so it stays live (V4 s5). The drawing must not drive a regeneration; fly-stitching has no plate of its own and its other two options (Curved / Straight Fly Stitch) have no drawing at all. The supplier publishes no fly-stitch field with artwork - GBKLI was examined and rejected (unmeasured technique values against our measured gauges).
